title: Actions with InputEventJoypadMotion events fire incorrectly
body:
### Tested versions

v4.6.2.stable.official [71f334935]

### System information

Ubuntu, Wayland

### Issue description

for example, an action with an event mapping like joypad axis moved leftwards is set on events where the joypad axis is moved rightwards.

the default `InputMap` has left stick moved left mapped to built-in `ui_left`
and left stick moved right mapped to built-in action `ui_right`.

`_gui_input` receives events where both `ui_left` and `ui_right` is true at the same time.

please see reproduction steps and MRP for details.

### Steps to reproduce

1. create a clean project.
2. observe the `InputEventJoypadMotion` events, for instance like so:
```swift
func _gui_input(event: InputEvent):
	if event is not InputEventJoypadMotion:
		return

	# We are only interested in the left stick X axis for this test
	if event.axis != JOY_AXIS_LEFT_X:
		return

	if event.is_action(&"ui_left"):
		printt("ui_left with axis value", event.axis_value)

	if event.is_action(&"ui_right"):
		printt("ui_right with axis value", event.axis_value)
```
3. move your left analog stick to the left.
4. note that the incoming event somehow maps to both `ui_left` AND `ui_right` at the same time.
5. note that it maps to `ui_right` despite printing a negative X axis value (right would be positive).

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[godot_4_joy_axis_bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26448795/godot_4_joy_axis_bug.zip)
